name: Fuzzy Customer Entity Resolution across Disparate Data Sources
description: Merging CRM and billing databases requires linking customers with slight name and address variations (e.g. 'Robert Smith, 123 Main St' vs 'Bob Smith, 123 Main Street').
prompt:
Merging CRM and billing databases requires linking customers with slight name and address variations (e.g. 'Robert Smith, 123 Main St' vs 'Bob Smith, 123 Main Street').

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: crm_id, crm_name, bill_id, billing_name, zip_code, name_similarity.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Entity resolution: Match records with identical zip code and Jaro-Winkler name similarity >= 0.80
            SELECT 
                c.crm_id,
                c.name AS crm_name,
                b.bill_id,
                b.name AS billing_name,
                c.zip_code,
                ROUND(jaro_winkler_similarity(c.name, b.name), 4) AS name_similarity
            FROM crm_records c
            JOIN billing_records b
              ON c.zip_code = b.zip_code
             AND jaro_winkler_similarity(c.name, b.name) >= 0.80
            ORDER BY name_similarity DESC;
why_it_fails: Pairwise fuzzy string matching over millions of records is computationally prohibitive without blocking/canopy clustering.
